name: TetraSDF Training Procedure
definition: Optimizes a neural network to represent a signed distance field (SDF) using a multi-resolution tetrahedral grid, combining L1 regression, Eikonal regularization, and weight normalization constraints.
summary: TetraSDF Training optimizes a neural network to represent signed distance fields using a multi-resolution tetrahedral grid, distinguishing itself from standard MLPs by enabling efficient multi-resolution handling and specific mesh extraction.
